newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sugar buys 30,000T US soy/corn at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sugar buys 30,000T US soy/corn at tender.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp on Wednesday bought a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow corn and 12,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow soybeans from Mitsui, traders said.
The maximun moisture limits for the shipment are 14.5 percent for the corn and 13.5 percent for the soybeans, the traders said.
The combined shipment is slated for delivery from the U.S. Gulf of Mexico from November 1 to 15 with freight fixed at US$17.50 per tonne.
